about_the_game:
[Story]

The protagonist, a loser in life, challenges the last gamble to win [money and women] in exchange for a lifetime of coal mine slavery.

Challenge the biggest gambling house on earth called 'Babel'!!! Babel only deals with one game, the 'JANKEN' game, which is the fairest and most perfect balance in the world!

Win [money, women] with advanced psychological warfare and luck.

[How to play]

*Play with scissors, rocks, and beam cards.

*Get 2 cards each, totaling 6 cards.

*Submit 1 card per turn to win or lose.

*When you win, you will see your stake and an image of the event.

*You lose when your fortune reaches $0.

[Game Tips]

*You can increase your chances of winning by using the various items you get each turn appropriately.
